answer_1.quote: Recent advancements in augmenting Large Language Models (LLMs) with auxiliary information have significantly revolutionized their efficacy in knowledge-intensive tasks.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs are answers to questions in a QA setting, generated by LLMs using either retrieved, generated, or hybrid contexts.

answer_2.quote: Initially, We employ the exact match metric to evaluate the correctness of candidate answers derived from contexts, considering an answer correct if its normalized form matches any of the golden answers.
